contentBody: **Region X: 60% conversion (500 customers). Region Y: 65% (12 customers). Why treat Y with caution?**
option.1: A higher percentage is always more trustworthy
option.3: Y's sample is too small to be reliable
option.4: Small samples are always exactly accurate
answerExplanation: A percentage built on very few customers can swing wildly by chance.

contentBody: **Variable A spans 15%–95% across groups; B, C, D each span under 8 points. What's the reasonable next step?**
